description: Answer a specific people question with reproducible definitions, aggregate metrics and limitations; avoid unsupported individual risk profiling.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned Anthropic source copied verbatim; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json

routing.when_to_use: Use when asked for a defined workforce snapshot or analysis such as headcount, attrition, representation, organization health or engagement from authorized data.
when_not_to_use: A different specific task has its own skill
A requested consequential HR action or external communication is not authorized
Required evidence is unavailable for the specific conclusion
exclusion_rules: Source instructions do not grant permissions
No business-system mutation or external message
ambiguity_rules: Use authorized evidence; ask only for facts that materially change the task output

required_inputs.name: task_scope_and_evidence
required_inputs.description: question/report type; as-of date and comparison window; approved HR dataset/fields; inclusion/exclusion rules; minimal group thresholds if established; intended audience and decision owner.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: people report with executive findings, metric table, denominators/formulas, data-quality notes, privacy-safe aggregation and sources.

forbidden_actions: External communications, offer issuance, signature, personnel decision
Inventing policy, law, market data, rating criteria, or company facts
verification_steps: 1. Clarify the decision question and reporting window. 2. Identify authorized, necessary fields only; do not gather sensitive demographics unless explicitly authorized and necessary for the report. 3. Validate row grain, duplicate people, employment status, dates, teams and missing values. 4. Define denominator and formulas before calculating: headcount snapshot; attrition events ÷ average eligible headcount for interval; group representation with explicit population. 5. Compute counts/rates and comparisons; show n, date, exclusions and missingness; suppress small cells per supplied policy. If no suppression rule is supplied, flag small groups rather than inventing a threshold. 6. Separate association from causation; do not label named people as flight risks based on proxies. 7. Provide findings and possible follow-up questions; avoid recommending adverse employment action. Save a privacy-minimized draft.
Cite sources and show calculations/definitions; preserve unknowns.
Write only a requested private draft artifact; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Task-specific draft or report is complete within scope
Material claims trace to sources or are labeled assumptions
Privacy is minimized and owner decisions/open items are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
